project.researchNotes: Townscape Guides batch audit completed 2026-08-12. Historic England and current public OpenStreetMap records were filtered point-in-polygon. The original settlement boundary is preserved in townStudyArea; 2 directly adjoining public green-space geometries were included in the active visitor boundary. Historic England official list-entry date enrichment reviewed 2026-08-12: 21 of 31 statutory records now carry defensible date evidence; uncaptured or unresolved entries are retained as unknown and listed in the county audit.

touristAppeal.label: Notable Stop
touristAppeal.summary: A compact historic village stop centred on the publicly accessible Church of St Nicholas and its immediate village setting. Nearby Burton Mere is treated separately and does not inflate the settlement score.

townGuide.headline: Burton: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Burton offers CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS, RSPB Burton Mere, REMAINS OF WINDMILL within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: CHURCH OF ST NICHOLAS
